sourceFinding.confirmed: AppHandle::exit queues RequestExit. Previous main CloseRequested handler did not prevent default owner destruction before dispatch of the queued application-exit event.
sourceFinding.notProven: Exact blocking stack is unknown. Owner/child destruction ordering is a candidate mechanism, not a proven native deadlock root cause.
sourceFinding.change: Prevent main default close before requesting normal application exit. Add opt-in fixed-code lifecycle tracing via SIDERA_EXIT_TRACE=1. No forced-exit fallback or session storage changes.
